**Performance: pass-with-notes** at `9cdcf3d8fac96966067901d6b8966d1cf76b844b`.

Delta review from `2d2f04e592bc405fa958f8954fa86f0a94748cad`, carrying forward [the full round-2 cost verdict](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/pull/167#issuecomment-6713944770), governance `6f79bf7`.

**Round 3:** `f86151bf` changes the pending order and matching partial index from `(seat, admitted_at)` to `(seat, seq)`. The existing query still selects the same three fields; the daemon still reverses the returned vector and reuses the newer row's delivery result. No extra SELECT, registry read, loop, timer, poll or executable site. The steady-state price remains one schema check plus one empty pending-index query per existing nominal 60-second watchdog round. With pending rows, the existing O(P*N) seat matching, conditional outcome/event/queue/holdings reads and retained-history qualifications remain.

**Admission cost is not literally unchanged.** `seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT` aliases the existing rowid; `(seat, msg_id)` remains UNIQUE. SQLite maintains a per-table high-water mark in `sqlite_sequence` inside the existing admission transaction, adding CPU and storage/I/O bookkeeping per insert attempt, not per watchdog round or seat. Committed `INSERT OR IGNORE` replays still create no second compaction row, but can consume sequence values and update that bookkeeping: dedup is not a no-write guarantee. See [SQLite's AUTOINCREMENT contract](https://www.sqlite.org/autoinc.html). This event-driven surcharge is acceptable for the requested never-reuse ordering invariant; no new transaction or application query was added.

The new CI regression exercises both a ten-minute backward clock step and equal admission clocks. The later tracking row wakes once and the earlier row is superseded. This repairs ordering, not elapsed-time measurement: `admitted_at` still supplies the undelivered age, and delivery timestamps still supply the settle age. No monotonic wake-latency guarantee is established.

**Merged main/#169:** the observer, tmux adapter/tests, retirement guards, PA digest model/tests and daemon-cost documentation match `a2cc5e70` byte-for-byte. Read the overlapping service/watchdog merge additions: they preserve #169's shared refusal state, retired census wiring and in-process digest projection; no extra merge-created launch or timer. Carry forward #169's `059163d` qualifications and deployed `38d3cf6` measurement, not a new #167 measurement.

**CI:** [42423682724](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42423682724) succeeds at this exact SHA, including Rust lint/test and Node 22/24 checks. Downloaded JUnit records **2,182 executed cases, zero failures/errors**, including **ten daemon compaction cases**, the core message case and **all six launch guards**. The new clock-order case passes. Delivers run `42423682845` succeeds; the other cancelled duplicate is not execution proof. Worktree HEAD and GitHub head agree; GitHub reports CLEAN/MERGEABLE.

No local build, test, mutation or runtime probe. **#167 after-deploy readings remain owed**, together with real wake latency/failure/retention evidence. Existing at-most-one-attempt, pending/history growth and conditional one-hour cleanup notes stand.
